core_obligations: Existence and description (proof lines 2342-2347): the sheafification functor is a left adjoint, hence commutes with all colimits; since presheaves have colimits, the images of the presheaf colimits under sheafification are colimits in the category of sheaves, which is the asserted description.
proof_roadmap: Recall that sheafification is a left adjoint and commutes with colimits.
Use that colimits of presheaves exist.
Conclude that the corresponding sheafification is a colimit of sheaves.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the colimit of a diagram of sheaves exists and is computed as the sheafification of the colimit of the same diagram computed in presheaves (statement lines 2330-2339). The proof is a short but complete argument: sheafification is a left adjoint and therefore commutes with all colimits, and since presheaves have colimits this exhibits the sheafifications of those colimits as colimits in the category of sheaves (proof lines 2342-2347). The non-formal content is the adjunction argument. The claim is H1: a one-step argument with its input named.
